0: List all chickpea varieties with who developed them, yield, seed size, maturity and disease resistance
3: Turn this dataset into a graph model
4: Make a quick change to the model
Import the dataset into the graph model

Show the whole graph on canvas

copy.welcome: Tell me what you're researching. I'll collect the data with a source behind every value, build a table you can edit, then help you model it as a graph and explore it.
copy.blank: New session on a blank canvas. Datasets and graph models are shared, so you can start from any of them.
copy.branched: Branched from **{parent}**{at}. I copied its canvas ({nodes} nodes) and conversation. Anything you do here stays in this branch.
copy.fallback: This prototype follows a scripted path. Try one of the suggestions, or ask about a specific variety, like “Tell me about Anvaya”.

need.2: Let’s build the dataset first. Ask me to list the chickpea varieties.
need.3: Save the dataset first so the graph model points at a fixed version.
need.4: There’s no graph model yet. Ask me to turn the saved dataset into one.
need.5: Import the dataset into the graph model first, then I can answer questions over it.

copy.schema: Here are the columns I’d collect for a breeding dataset. Turn off anything you don’t need, then I’ll search variety release notices, trial reports and germplasm databases, and cite each value.
copy.collecting: Collecting now. You can watch the table fill in.
copy.draft: Draft ready: **{rows} varieties** from **{sources} sources**. {conflicts}Sahyadri has no releasing institution in any source. Click any cell to see where it came from.
copy.draftConflicts: {n} cells have values that differ between sources; they're marked in the table.
copy.drought: Added **Drought tolerance** for all {rows} varieties, rated High, Medium or Low. Every value comes from the germplasm passport database [6].
copy.droughtThere: The drought tolerance column is already in the table.
copy.colAsk: What column should I add? I can research the values with sources, or leave it empty for you to fill.
copy.colPreset: Added **{name}** for all {rows} varieties from the germplasm passport database [6].
copy.colNone: I couldn't find sources for **{name}** in this prototype, so I added it empty. Double-click a cell to fill it in.
copy.colEmpty: Added an empty **{name}** column. Double-click a cell to fill it in.
copy.conflictAsk: These cells have different values in different sources. Pick the value to keep for each; the other stays on record.
copy.noConflicts: No conflicts left. Every value agrees across its sources.
copy.kept: Kept **{value}** for {name} · {column}, from source [{source}]. {left} conflict{s} left.
copy.saveAsk: Name this version and I’ll save it with its citations.
copy.saved: Saved **{name} {version}**: {rows} rows, {columns} columns{sources}.{open} Next, I can organize it as a graph model.
copy.model: Here’s how I’d organize the dataset as a graph. Each row becomes a **Variety**. Institutions, traits, zones and parent lines become their own nodes, so you can ask things like “which parents show up across wilt-resistant lines”.
copy.modelReady: Model created. Review it as a form, check the column mapping, or edit the model file directly. When it looks right, ask me to import it or press Import on the model page.
copy.meditAsk: What would you like to change in the model?
copy.importAsk: Check the import settings, then start it.
copy.importIssues: The model has {n} issue{s} to fix before import: {list}
copy.imported: Import finished. The graph is ready to explore.
copy.merged: Merged into the existing graph: {nodes} new node{ns} and {edges} new relationship{es}. Matching nodes were updated by key.
copy.importStopped: Import stopped while transforming rows. {n} row{s} {have} a missing value, and nothing was written to the graph. Fill the cell or import again and choose to skip it.
copy.searchAgain: None of the extra sources name a releasing institution for Sahyadri with confidence. I left the cell empty and flagged it, so the import will skip its DEVELOPED_BY relationship. You can type the value in if you know it.
copy.institutions: Varieties released per institution. {lead} Sahyadri isn't counted because its institution is unknown.
copy.decades: Average yield has risen from {first} q/ha in the {firstLabel} to {last} q/ha in the {lastLabel}. Each point averages the varieties released in that decade.
copy.wilt: {n} kabuli varieties are resistant to Fusarium wilt and yield at least 18 q/ha. {top}
copy.whole: Loaded the whole graph on **{canvas}**: {n} nodes. Click a node for its details and sources, or drag to rearrange.
copy.notFound: I couldn't find “{name}” in the graph.
